title: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepathic planeswalker who, one year earlier, tries to use the sylex, is compleated, resists phyresis from within his own mind, and saves Vraska.

entities.name: Phyrexian Jace Beleren
entities.description: The compleated Phyrexian version of Jace, which takes over his body and which he fights from within his mind.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Jace's beloved, compleated by Phyrexia but preserved in a secret recess of her mind, whom Jace rescues.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian Mother of Machines, who offers Jace's friends a place among the One and commands him to go home.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Jace's mother and a healer, in whose home Jace and Vraska collapse.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and Jace's friend, who spits on Elesh Norn's invitation.

entities.name: Kaito
entities.description: A planeswalker and Jace's friend, who declines Norn's invitation casually.

entities.name: Tyvar
entities.description: A planeswalker who refuses Elesh Norn's offer.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A dead friend of Jace, imagined waiting for him in a shining cloud.

entities.name: Kallist
entities.description: A dead friend imagined waiting alongside Gideon.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: A planeswalker who once hissed a Dominarian adage about Urza at Jace.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The last person to use the sylex, a man who was not righteous.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon whose sabotage Jace and Vraska once planned, and a superior researcher to Norn.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: A sphinx who made Jace commit crimes at Vryn and erased his mind.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading force whose invasion Jace tries to end with the sylex.

entities.name: The Invasion Tree
entities.description: The Phyrexian tree where Jace takes the sylex.

entities.name: Useless Island
entities.description: An island in Jace's mind where he retreats.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane, which he sealed behind a wall, and where phyresis took him to cause a battlefield massacre.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane at war with Phyrexians where Jace finds Vraska.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, which Jace perceives as layers of glass.

entities.name: Phyresis
entities.description: The Phyrexian oil-based transformation that reshapes minds and bodies.

entities.name: The sylex
entities.description: An ancient artifact that annihilates the Multiverse, which Jace attempts to use.

entities.name: The Halo
entities.description: A substance in a sword that lets Jace regain consciousness from phyresis.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The earlier war on Ravnica that the Phyrexian war recalls.

events.summary: One year earlier, Jace stands at the Invasion Tree with his hands on the sylex, convinced the Multiverse must restart.
events.quote: Jace has his hands on the sylex, Phyrexia will succeed in their invasion

events.summary: Jace says goodbye to Kaya and Kaito and chooses not to command them to sleep.
events.quote: His last kindness in all their last breaths will allow them their agency.

events.summary: Jace activates the sylex, surrenders, and cuts himself to pour his misery into it.
events.quote: Jace grasps the sylex and, as he does, surrenders.

events.summary: Jace is compleated, and his Phyrexian self takes control while his mind retreats inward.
In his mind, Jace finds a safe copy of Useless Island, then is pulled back into the physical world by a riptide.
events.quote: it appears he made, deep inside himself, a holdout for his mind

events.summary: Jace wakes in his body with a sword through his chest, and plays dead behind an illusion.
events.quote: Jace glances down and sees a sword sticking through his chest

events.summary: Elesh Norn offers his friends a place among the One, and Tyvar, Kaito and Kaya refuse.
Jace skims Elesh Norn's mind and learns she has commanded him to go home to Vryn.
events.quote: Go home , commands the Mother of Machines, go home.

events.summary: Jace's body planeswalks to Vryn as phyresis reclaims him.
events.quote: His body exits the aether of the Blind Eternities and steps onto the wet soil of a plane he hasn't seen in years.

events.summary: On the beach in his mind, Jace commands his body to fight the oil as a virus.
events.quote: THE OIL IN YOUR VEINS IS A VIRUS.

events.summary: Jace briefly sees through his body's eyes at Vryn, where his Phyrexian self has seized dozens of soldiers.
events.quote: Twenty soldiers seize in front of him, their minds singing to Jace's in a static cacophony.

events.summary: Jace commands his body to sleep and succeeds.
events.quote: YOU ARE ASLEEP. YOU ARE ASLEEP. YOU ARE ASLEEP.

events.summary: Jace wakes in a ravine feverish, tears out a cable from his arm and decides to save Vraska.
events.quote: he grasps one of the cables in his arm and rips it out.

events.summary: Jace planeswalks to Ravnica, which is at war with the Phyrexians, and searches for Vraska's mind.
Jace finds Vraska wounded and compleated on a rooftop, and learns she has hidden herself in a mental recess.
events.quote: Her body is a mess of broken burned chrome.

events.summary: Jace performs five simultaneous telepathic feats to reverse Vraska's phyresis and carries her into the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: he closes his eyes and performs five miracles at once.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska collapse in the home of Jace's mother Ranna, a healer.
events.quote: Ranna Beleren, ever in control, hides her alarm at the bleeding monsters that fell into her living room.

events.summary: Jace pleads with his mother for help before passing out.
events.quote: Please help us, Mom. I'm so sorry.

relations.quote: Please help us, Mom. I'm so sorry.

relations.note: Jace calls Vraska his beloved and tells her he loves her.
Elesh Norn is the Mother of Machines leading the invasion forces here.
relations.quote: The Mother of Machines waxes poetic

relations.note: Alhammarret made Jace commit crimes and erased his mind.
relations.quote: how the sphinx delighted in erasing Jace's mind so the boy may produce yet another match.

relations.note: Jace looks at his allies and friends Kaya and Kaito.
relations.quote: his allies, his friends, Kaya and Kaito

relations.note: Kaito is among the friends Jace tries to persuade.
relations.quote: his allies, his friends, Kaya and Kaito

relations.note: The compleated version of Jace competes with his true mind for control of his body.
relations.quote: He can't tell if he wanted to retreat or if the Phyrexian version of himself compelled him.
